SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_distinct, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS mn, max(etl_loaded_at) AS mx
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-29' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH d AS (
 SELECT store_key, product_key, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT closing_units) AS du, count(DISTINCT closing_value) AS dv, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
 FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT count(*) AS dup_keys, sum(n) AS rows_, sum(CASE WHEN du>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differing_units, sum(CASE WHEN dv>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differing_value, min(first_load), max(first_load), min(last_load), max(last_load), count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores FROM d

WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-01'),
b AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08')
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, p.category, p.subcategory, count(*) n
FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_key, product_key)
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=a.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=a.product_key
WHERE b.store_key IS NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT cs.region, cs.store_id < 900 AS physical, p.category,
 count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units, sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_value IS NULL OR fs.closing_units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(fs.closing_value - fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_mismatch,
 count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND cs.region IN ('West') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date),
stock AS (
  SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week, params
  WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key, week_ending_date ORDER BY etl_loaded_at DESC) = 1
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM stock fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND cs.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category, COUNT(*) AS weeks, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_value
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
